edit.text: A 他们/它/其 standing for an organization or publication named in the same sentence is no new node: reuse its variable; a possessive 他们的 before an event noun adds no `:ARG0`. In a later sentence the pronoun is its own node, coreferred to the named entity, not to an earlier pronoun.

edit.new: 已经, 都, 也, 甚至, 还 and 其中 → `:mod (<word>)`, but no node for 就, for 还 after 后来, for 仍 beside 继续, or for 都 in 都以…为目的;

edit.text: Likewise a role noun before an organization name (母公司美国媒体公司): `company` with the name `:ARG1-of (identity-91 :ARG2 (公司 :mod (母)))`.

edit.old: and refer to it at later mentions in the same sentence by its bare variable (`:possessor s7n`).

edit.old: Within one sentence, coreference is a re-entrancy in the graph (one variable), not a `:coref` triple.
edit.new: Within one sentence, coreference is a re-entrancy (one variable), except a shortened name repeat (see 3).

edit.old: Never put a `:subset-of` triple inside one sentence.
